However, regarding specificity, the comment does clearly specify what needs to be addressed: making the implications of the theoretical results clearer, explaining how the theory applies to practical problems, and articulating the insight behind the analysis. According to the rubric, this combination — a referenced part that cannot be confidently identified combined with a clear specification of the issue — corresponds to the middle level of the scale rather than a completely ungrounded and highly unspecific comment.
